services.name: pub.streamProcessing:combineCalculations
description: WmPublic. Combines calculations made for an event trigger that uses a CALCULATE step as part of window processing. Use this service to combine the calculations from the current window with running calculations from earlier windows. Note: This service has been moved from the WmStreaming package to the WmPublic package. A deprecated copy remains in the WmStreaming package for backward compatibility, but it is hidden and must not be used. Use the service in the WmPublic package for all new development.

input_parameters.name: fromCalculations
description: A document (IData object) containing the values to combine with toCalculations .

children.name: count
description: Optional. Number of entries in the result set for the window. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: max
description: Optional. Maximum value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: min
description: Optional. Minimum value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: sum
description: Optional. Sum of the values for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: first
description: Optional. The first value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied.

children.name: last
description: Optional. The last value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied.

input_parameters.name: toCalculations
description: A document (IData object) containing the calculations to combine with fromCalculations .

children.name: count
description: Optional. Number of entries in the result set for the window. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: max
description: Optional. Maximum value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: min
description: Optional. Minimum value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: sum
description: Optional. Sum of the values for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied. The supplied value must be a number that is represented as a String.

children.name: first
description: Optional. The first value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied.

children.name: last
description: Optional. The last value for the parameter in the window to which the CALCULATE step was applied.

output_parameters.name: toCalculations
description: The toCalculations document (IData object) combined with the values in fromCalculations .

children.name: average
description: Conditional. Average value calculated from the combined sum and count. Computed as sum divided by count, rounded to 3 decimal places. This value is returned only if both sum and count were included in fromCalculations and/or toCalculations, and count is not zero.

children.name: count
description: Conditional. Combined count from the calculations. Sum of the input toCalculations/count and the input fromCalculations/count . This value is returned only if count was included in fromCalculations and/or toCalculations.

children.name: max
description: Conditional. Maximum value in the combined result calculations for the parameter to which the CALCULATE step was applied. This value is returned only if max was included in fromCalculations and/or toCalculations.

children.name: min
description: Conditional. Minimum value in the combined result calculations for the parameter to which the CALCULATE step was applied. This value is returned only if min was included in fromCalculations and/or toCalculations.

children.name: sum
description: Conditional. Sum of the sum values in the combined results sets for the parameter to which the CALCULATE step was applied. This value is returned only if sum was included in fromCalculations and/or toCalculations.

children.name: first
description: Conditional. The first value in the combined results for the parameter to which the CALCULATE step was applied. This value is returned only if first was included in fromCalculations and/or toCalculations.

children.name: last
description: Conditional. The last value in the combined results for the parameter to which the CALCULATE step was applied. This value is returned only if last was included in fromCalculations and/or toCalculations.

usage_notes: The CALCULATE step in event processing applies to a specific parameter. A common use case for the pub.streamProcessing:combineCalculations service is to maintain running calculations that span multiple windows. For example, if you had an event trigger that produced calculations for each minute of the day, you could use this service to cache the results for the entire day. This can be done in the event trigger target service using the following steps: 1. Fetch the running calculations from the cache. 2. Combine the current window's calculations with the running calculations using the pub.streamProcessing:combineCalculations service. 3. Write the new calculations back to the cache.
